# Britannica Curiosity Compass

> > A science-based curiosity assessment platform from Britannica that helps users discover their curiosity type and learning style through interactive quizzes.

Britannica's Curiosity Compass explores the psychology and science of curiosity, offering personality-type assessments that classify users as Explorers, Discoverers, and other curiosity profiles. The platform features biographical examples of famous curious minds including Marie Curie, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Malala Yousafzai, Amelia Earhart, and Anthony Bourdain to illustrate different approaches to learning and discovery.
